sloka: इमाम् तु पश्चिमाम् वाचम् व्याजहार पिता तव ।काल धर्म परिक्षिप्तः पाशैः इव महा गजः ॥२-७२-३७॥
transliteration: imām tu paścimām vācam vyājahāra pitā tava ।kāla dharma parikṣiptaḥ pāśaiḥ iva mahā gajaḥ ॥2-72-37॥

translations.english: Your father, caught by the noose of death, like a great elephant bound by cords, uttered these last words:
